elements.title: Value of Crushed Stone Produced in 2023, by State
elements.content: Map of the United States with states colored by value of crushed stone production in million dollars. Color legend: Withheld (gray), <100 (cream), 100 to 500 (light orange), >500 to 1,000 (orange), >1,000 (red). Black dots indicate crushed stone operations scattered across states. Insets show Alaska and Hawaii with similar dot distribution and color coding.
